style_base: Iconic sportswear campaign photography, modern stadium architecture, graphite concrete and asphalt tones, hard directional light with deep clean shadows, minimal composition, editorial retouch, expensive premium styling.
negative: No forest, no trees, no park, no grass, no cap, no hat, no messy hair, no cheap clothes, no watermark, no logo, no brand marks, no cartoon, no Asian or African features.
